mapper.sql: id, email, email_verified, orcid, display_name, time_zone, digest_frequency, digest_weekday, digest_hour, digest_since, created, last_login
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_user WHERE lower(email) = lower(#{email})

INSERT INTO app_user (email, email_verified, orcid, display_name, time_zone, digest_frequency, digest_weekday, digest_hour, digest_since) VALUES (#{o.email}, #{o.emailVerified}, #{o.orcid}, #{o.displayName}, COALESCE(#{o.timeZone}, 'UTC'), COALESCE(#{o.digestFrequency}, 'DAILY'), COALESCE(#{o.digestWeekday}, 1), COALESCE(#{o.digestHour}, 7), #{o.digestSince}) RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET email = #{email}, email_verified = now(), digest_since = COALESCE(digest_since, now()) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_user SET orcid = #{orcid} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_user SET last_login = now() WHERE id = #{id}
